name: architectai
description: ArchitectAI — enterprise AI architecture governance platform (monorepo)

scripts.dev:local: pnpm --filter @architectai/shared build && pnpm --filter @architectai/config build && pnpm --filter @architectai/api dev:staging & pnpm --filter @architectai/web dev
scripts.staging:local: pnpm staging:infra && pnpm staging:api & pnpm --filter @architectai/web dev
scripts.staging:infra: pnpm --filter @architectai/shared build && pnpm --filter @architectai/config build && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d && sleep 3 && pnpm --filter @architectai/api migrate
scripts.staging:quick: pnpm --filter @architectai/shared build && pnpm --filter @architectai/config build && pnpm --filter @architectai/api dev:staging & pnpm --filter @architectai/web dev
